name: The recall memory kept across episodes and keyed by its predecessor: six recipes on P1's first 12 founders
question: Does a recall memory whose slots outlive an episode (recall_episodes keep), keyed by the event heard together with the previous moment and the last command (recall_key predecessor), raise sampled success on the aliased views and on P1 against the same memory that forgets its episodes or keys on the event alone?
scope: component witness of two recall options in a world; not a gate of the library branch

recall.note: the recall memory at the pull request's founder genes (episodes forgotten, the key the event heard)

base.note: recall with the power-law recency (recall_recency None) and 256 slots, episodes forgotten, the key the event heard

keep.note: base with recall_episodes keep: the slots outlive every episode's end, in the life and in its reading (Brain.reset(keep_memory=True) before each read episode)

pred.note: base with recall_key predecessor: the key carries the previous moment's event and the last command

keep_pred.note: base with kept episodes and the predecessor key

correct_step_qualified.note: the same caregiver with qualified teaching; a separately named numerical arm, refusals counted at the fixed budget

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

withdrawal: the acquired life resumes from its seam with the caregiver gone and learning on; a separate frozen copy is read at the end

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start equals the life's episode boundary for an act-only reader; one greedy episode, since every greedy episode from a reset reads the same deterministic answers

seeds.note: one runner process per view (or P1) and founder, every recipe in each

analysis.unit: founder; a pair is one arm on one founder, one recipe against another
analysis.C1: keep_pred - base per view (founder-resampled 95% intervals, each founder's arms averaged on the screen)
analysis.C2: keep - base, pred - base: the two options alone
analysis.C3: keep_pred - founder per view at or above -.05 (preservation) and the P1 gate (every arm's upper interval end of keep_pred - founder in sampled success after teaching at or above zero)
analysis.reference: base - recall (the power-law recency and 256 slots) and recall - founder
